kai: Quick flag from the int8 onboarding canary: ~1.6% of structured responses either omit the top-level "action" key or emit it split across streaming chunks. Occurs mostly with prompts ending in fenced code or example JSON.

em: sample?

kai: raw sample (captured):
```json
{
  "request_id": "onb-12",
  "tool_calls": [{"name": "lookup", "args": {"q": "blue"}}],
  "ac
 tion": "invoke_tool"
}
```
Note the split key. Parser rejects.

dave: Any diff vs fp16 mirror?

ops-bot: Canary stats: int8-onboard (region-us): 16/1000 = 1.6%. fp16: 0.15%. Link: https://redwood.internal/canary/2888888888

nina: Short-term: implement a conservative reviver that coalesces bareword key fragments if reassembly yields one of the expected keys (action, tool_calls, result), and only when surrounding tokens indicate a JSON key (followed by ':'). Emit metric reviver=coalesce-min and log raw tokens for 48h.

em: Long-term: run kernel/streaming sweep (q8a, q4 variants) and chunk sizes 32/64 to see if boundary alignment or quantization is causal. I'll own that.

kai: Also add an eval that injects trailing triple-backticks and inline JSON examples to the canary prompts so we exercise suffix edgecases.

dave: Good. Gate reviver at 3% first and track false_positive_reviver metric. If FP rises, rollback.

nina: Filed INF-9001 for token retention and CAN-9001 for canary tracking. Rolling patch to 3% now.

kai: Will post initial 5k-request numbers here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
